questions.q: Spot the mistakes: find and fix the 5 misspelled words.
questions.answer: kichen → kitchen; cach → catch; sketsh → sketch; dich → ditch; huch → hutch
questions.hint: Look at words with the /ch/ sound after a short vowel.
questions.text: Sam ran to the kichen to get a snack. His dog ran to cach a ball. Then they went out to sketsh a tree by the dich. Sam saw a rabbit in its huch and gave it a carrot.

questions.answer: fech → fetch; pach → patch; mach → match; wich → witch
questions.hint: Find words with /ch/ after a short vowel.
questions.text: Mia had a red cat. The cat liked to fech a toy mouse. One day the cat tore a hole in Mia's coat, so Mum sewed a pach on it. Then Mia and Mum played a mach of snap. Her cat sat by the wich hat.
